 "content": "def transform(grid):
    doubled = [row[::-1] + row for row in grid]
    base = doubled[::-1] + doubled + doubled[::-1]
    out = []
    for k in range(3):
        out.extend(base[k*len(grid):(k+1)*len(grid)] if k != 1 else base[len(grid):2*len(grid)])
    # The pattern is vertically reflected every block of input height, except middle block uses central sequence.
    out = doubled[::-1] + doubled + doubled[::-1]
    return out
